completeness.why: Every provider function keeps only its bank lookup and passes its data to linkBankSyncAccount, which does upgrade-or-insert (with the missing-account throw), the transfer payee, syncAccount, handleSyncResponse and the sync-event; the file id, the insert fields and Akahu's tables are explicit arguments; Enable Banking's unreachable id check is dropped.

interface.why: Parameters match the real variations (syncSource, bank, external id, insert fields, optional fileId, tables) with no speculative options and the Akahu table difference commented; newAccountFields as Record<string, unknown> and syncSource as string are loosely typed, and each caller rebuilds the same offbudget/name fields.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied sequence is removed into linkBankSyncAccount; only short per-provider field objects remain at the call sites.
